thread:
ana (PM): Quick sync: propose a small, focused observability MVP for the Console we can realistically ship in 2 sprints. Scope idea: 1) per-route cost heatmap + CSV export, 2) hot-path trace link from latency spikes, 3) error-trend widget with grouped alerts. Keep it narrow and pilot-driven. Thoughts?
leo (eng): Sounds good. For cost heatmap we'll need a new request label (route_name) emitted from the API layer. Minimal schema change: metric 'tokens_consumed' -> tag with route_name. Backend changes ~6 dev-days + a read-optimized view for UI queries.
ruth (sre): Tracing: prefer a sampling strategy that minimizes tracer overhead. Suggest default sample rate 0.5% for high-volume routes, 100% on errors and on internal debug toggles. Need to expose trace_id in response headers to allow console deep-linking.
sam (design): UI will be three compact cards. Heatmap uses route rows x time columns with sparkline + top routes list. Latency card shows p50/p95 and a big "open trace" CTA when spike detected. Error widget groups by signature and shows trend + example request. I can mock by EOD Wed.
maria (cs): Customers A and B want per-deployment and per-route CSV export to feed into cost models. They also asked for timezone-aware exports and a quick-compare mode (this week vs last week). Make export columns: timeframe_start, timeframe_end, route_name, deployment_id, tokens, estimated_cost_usd.
nana (PM): (typo fix) meant ana above :)
nana (PM): Launch criteria proposal: templates present in Console, at least one pilot customer actively using cost CSV + trace links, docs + release notes, and automated annotation of traces for errors >0.75% over 24h. Ship target: end of sprint 4.
leo (eng): Implementation risk: tagging rollout needs a feature flag to avoid breaking historical metrics. Backfill is optional but heavy; recommend GA without backfill and an opt-in historical backfill job later. Also need a small mapping endpoint route_name -> model_variant for the UI. +2 dev-days.
ruth (sre): Alerting: group incidents by error fingerprint (status+stack-snippet). Rate-limit alerts per-customer to avoid floods. Example alert rubric: if error_rate > 0.0075 for 24h trigger warning, >0.02 escalate and include top trace link.
sam (design): Copy proposal for toggles: 'Capture full traces on errors' and 'Show route-level cost estimates'. Add a tooltip: 'Cost estimates are based on model-typical token pricing and may vary.'
maria (cs): Pilot plan: recruit Customer A (early adopter) and Customer C (security-focused) to validate dedicated/private flows. Need admin-only toggle for billing-export and an opt-out for PII-sensitive routes.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: feature-branch/obs-mini-mvp passed CI :white_check_mark:.
leo (eng): For trace deep-linking, we'll add X-Trace-ID header. Need product review for exposing that header in hosted vs private (privacy concerns).
nana (PM): Keep header off by default for hosted; enable for Dedicated/Private after consent. Document clearly.
ruth (sre): Sampling config we'd land in ops docs example:
```yaml
tracing:
  high_volume_default: 0.005  # 0.5%
  full_on_error: true
  error_capture_threshold: 0.0075
  expose_trace_header: false
```
leo (eng): CSV endpoint: /api/v1/observability/costs/export?start=...&end=...&routes=... returns gzipped CSV. Will add pagination and rate-limits.
nana (PM): Priority: P1 for Dedicated/Private (customer asks), P2 hosted. Rollout phasing: internal QA -> two pilots -> GA. Action items: @leo prototyping route_name tag + mapping endpoint (due 2026-04-02), @sam high-fidelity mocks by 2026-03-26, @ruth ops doc + alert rules by 2026-03-27, @maria pilot outreach this week.
maria (cs): Reaching out now. Will confirm pilots by Fri.
leo (eng): Ack, starting spike.
sam (design): Ack.
ruth (sre): Ack.
